title: Potato, Sausage and Egg Breakfast Casserole
description: An easy breakfast recipe of shredded hash brown potatoes, Egg Beaters®, sausage, red bell pepper and Cheddar cheese baked together.
ingredients: 1 serving PAM® Original No-Stick Cooking Spray
4 frozen Banquet® Brown 'N Serve™ Turkey Sausage links, sliced
2 cups refrigerated shredded hash brown potatoes

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Spray 8x8-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray; set aside.
Combine Egg Beaters®, milk and garlic salt in large bowl. Add sausage, potatoes, bell pepper and cheese; stir to combine. Place mixture in dish.
Bake 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool slightly before serving.

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make an easy breakfast casserole with hash brown potatoes, sausage, bell peppers, Cheddar cheese, and Egg Beaters®. It’s so easy to put together, perfect for when you have last minute guests.
